spans: Neither party may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the other party's written consent (which will not be unreasonably delayed or withheld), except that no such consent will be required in connection with an assignment or transfer of this Agreement to (a) a party's successor in connection with a Change in Control of such party, provided that such successor is not a competitor of the other party, or (b) to any entity that is
controlled by, under common control with, or controls a party.
